sections.content:
**`constants.js` — `STATUS_BY_MARKER`**
- Unknown marker falls back to `STATUSES[0]` (used in `scanTasksInContent` but implicit)
- Aliases: `"X"` maps to `done`, `""` and `" "` both map to `open`

**`block-ids.js`**
- `hashString`: empty string, unicode, determinism
- `createUniqueBlockId`: collision — same base hash, loops to `-2`, `-3`
- `ensureTaskBlockIds`: task already has `^id` (skip), inside kanban block (skip), CRLF input
- `replaceOrInsertKanbanBlock`: existing block replacement trims whitespace correctly; no existing block + frontmatter (uses `findTopInsertIndex`)
- `removeKanbanBlock`: no kanban block present (returns unchanged); mismatched markers (end before start)
- `findTopInsertIndex`: no frontmatter → `0`; unclosed frontmatter → `0`; frontmatter with blank lines after

**`format.js`**
- `escapeTableText`: `&`, `<`, `>`, `|`, `\r\n`, `\n`, already-escaped strings
- `escapeAttribute`: `"` → `"` on top of `escapeTableText`
- `escapeMarkdownInline`: `*`, `_`, `[`, `]`, `\` all escaped

**`tasks.js`**
- `getIndentLevel`: tab=4, space=1, mixed
- `scanTasksInContent`: skip KANBAN_START…END block; nested subtasks (stack); priority emoji `🔥🔥`; blockId parsed; CRLF endings; heading tracking; unknown marker

**`state.js`**
- `sortTasksForKanban`: mode `default`, `touched`, `priority`; tiebreak by file path then line
- `getNextStatus`: wraps around (last status → first)
- `getNextSubtaskStatus`: status not in cycle → returns `SUBTASK_STATUS_CYCLE[0]`; wraps
- `getTaskTouchedKey`: null task, task with no path, blockId present vs absent
- `setTaskKanbanSortMode`: invalid value → `"default"`
- `getInlineLine`: null attr, `""`, non-numeric, valid int, float string
